## Install

Download the **`-setup.exe`** file below and run it. It installs for your user account, with no administrator rights
needed, and its window has a box for each extra:
- a Start menu shortcut
- a desktop shortcut
- `dvfiles-cli` on your Path
- "Open in dvfiles" on folder menus
- opening folders with dvfiles instead of File Explorer

Running it over an existing install updates it in place. Uninstall from Apps & features.

The **`-portable.exe`** file is `dvfiles.exe` alone, and **`-cli.exe`** is the command-line tool. Each `.sha256` file
holds the SHA-256 checksum of its download.
